description: THRESHOLD screen on the calendar year: every US $10B+ name up 100%+ year to date (the bar is a param), best first. For this week's moves use get_weekly_movers; for YTD inside one segment use get_market_heatmap.

min_market_cap.description: Minimum market cap in USD dollars. Default and floor 1e10 ($10B).

min_ytd.description: Minimum year-to-date gain in percent. Default 100 (doubled); 200 = tripled. Negative values clamp to 0.

name: get_ytd_leaders
